name: content-project-workflow
description: Run video, animation, and content projects with Claude Code like a small studio. Sets up a brief, a style guide, a list of every reference, and approval gates from storyboard to final render. A producer agent hands one shot at a time to builder, frame-checking reviewer, and researcher agents; built-in skills cover content basics, motion, design, and character design. Optional Vox editorial collage preset (HyperFrames, tested helper kit, caption karaoke from your own voice-over), a tools check that offers to install what production needs, and an audio kit for word timing, mastering, and delivery checks. Setup: /content-project-workflow:adopt (existing project) or :bootstrap (new folder).
